tasks.title: Add LLBL HostEval and role identity foundations
tasks.detail: Add `llbl.channel.index_host`, the `HostEval` tagged value with parsed/Lua constructors and cached evaluation, and qualified `RoleId` helpers (`llbl.role_id`, key/equality/display helpers). Do not change slot behavior yet. Preserve legacy `llbl.is(value, "Fragment")`/`llbl.is(value, "Spread")` behavior.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in `lua/llbl.lua`: added `llbl.channel.index_host`, HostEval tagged value/API (`llbl.host_eval(...)`, `.parsed`, `.lua`, cached `HostEval:evaluate/resolve`, shape/describe support), and qualified RoleId helpers (`llbl.role_id`, `llbl.role_id_key`, `llbl.role_id_display`, `llbl.role_id_equal`). Verified with an inline `luajit -e` HostEval/RoleId smoke check, `luajit tests/run.lua core` (17 passed), and `luajit tests/llpvm/test_llbl_language_algebra.lua`.

tasks.title: Introduce LLBL role descriptors and public role API
tasks.detail: Extend role specs into descriptors carrying qualified id, algebra, item_role, fragment_role, payload_role, adapter, splice_policy, nil_policy, and diagnostics metadata. Add `llbl.role.normalize/adapt/collect/splice/descriptor` entrypoints and wire `role_context`, `role_region_by_spec`, and collectors through descriptors while keeping existing reflective/codegen paths operational.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/llbl.lua: added RoleDescriptor-backed llbl.role_descriptor and llbl.role.{descriptor,id,display,adapt,normalize,collect,fragment_compatible,splice}; role_context now records role_descriptor/role_id/algebra; role_region_by_spec unwraps HostEval and honors descriptor adapters; array/product/sum spread paths go through llbl.role.splice; spread_region checks descriptor fragment compatibility; dialect construction materializes descriptors; describe_role reports role_id, item/fragment/payload roles, policies, and adapter presence. Checks: inline role API smoke via luajit; luajit tests/core/test_llbl_codegen.lua; luajit tests/run.lua core; luajit tests/llpvm/test_llbl_language_algebra.lua.

tasks.title: Qualify fragments and centralize splice compatibility
tasks.detail: Upgrade `llbl.fragment`, `Dialect:fragment`, `fragment_like`, `describe_fragment`, `spread_region`, and array/product/sum generators to use descriptor-based qualified fragment compatibility instead of plain string equality. Support explicit Spread plus descriptor-controlled bare fragment and HostEval fragment splicing.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/llbl.lua: llbl.fragment now attaches qualified role_id/container_role_id/owner metadata; fragment_like preserves qualified metadata; concat/choice accept matching role_id; Dialect:fragment uses descriptor-derived fragment_role/container role ids; describe_fragment reports qualified ids; role generators support explicit Spread, descriptor-controlled bare Fragment splicing, and HostEval values that evaluate to fragments; spread_region uses descriptor compatibility. Checks: luajit inline fragment qualification/bare/HostEval splice smoke; luajit tests/core/test_llbl_codegen.lua; luajit tests/run.lua core; luajit tests/llpvm/test_llbl_language_algebra.lua.

tasks.title: Route Lua index brackets through HostEval slot admission
tasks.detail: Change runtime and compiled stage index handling so `RuntimeStage.__index`/`CompiledStage.__index` wrap the already-evaluated Lua operand as `llbl.host_eval.lua(...)`, emit `index:host`, and let expected slot role decide adaptation. Update channel overlap, action_fits, ambiguity validation, and diagnostics to avoid raw shape pre-rejection for type slots.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/llbl.lua: RuntimeStage.__index and CompiledStage.__index/consume now wrap Lua index operands in llbl.host_eval.lua, emit index:host, preserve raw_value/legacy_channel on HostEval/Event, and stamp expected_role once a slot accepts the event. Type slots now advertise index:host/index:type and action_fits no longer pre-rejects by raw type shape; channel overlap/ambiguity labels handle index:host vs legacy index channels. Checks: inline IndexHostSmoke dialect showing a non-type table adapts through a type role adapter via Lua brackets and legacy index:type events still work; luajit tests/core/test_llbl_codegen.lua; luajit tests/run.lua core; luajit tests/llpvm/test_llbl_language_algebra.lua.

tasks.title: Add parsed HostEval channel support
tasks.detail: Add parsed host-eval channel names/exports (at minimum keep `parsed:escape` and add/use `parsed:host_eval`) and ensure `syntax.install` exposes them under `llbl.channel.parsed`. This is the LLBL syntax-side name used by Lalin parsed brackets.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/llbl/syntax/init.lua: added syntax.channel.parsed.host_eval = "parsed:host_eval" while preserving escape = "parsed:escape" as the legacy alias; syntax.install continues exporting syntax.channel.parsed through llbl.channel.parsed. Checks: inline luajit syntax channel install assertion; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Preserve constructor env for parsed HostEval
tasks.detail: Ensure parsed constructor `run` passes a stable env table/context that can be stored on/evaluate HostEval objects once. Do not adapt in the constructor; only provide enough env for HostEval evaluation and origin/owner metadata.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/llbl/syntax/constructor.lua: Constructor:run now places the stable lexical env table on ctx.env and provides ctx.evaluate_host(host_eval) that evaluates HostEval objects against that env without role adaptation; existing constructor/origin/owner metadata preserved. Checks: inline luajit Constructor HostEval env/evaluation smoke; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Plan parsed declaration stream HostEval support in driver
tasks.detail: Add driver hooks for active parsed languages to recognize bare bracket islands at statement/declaration-stream positions and route them to the language `parse_host_eval`/`parse_decl_stream` hook with an expected role. Preserve parsed expression indexing and normal Lua syntax; do not treat arbitrary Lua `[` as HostEval without a declared role.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/llbl/syntax/driver.lua: active syntax specs are tracked; make_ctx carries expected_role; descriptor_from recognizes synthetic __host_eval_stream entries and calls parse_decl_stream or parse_host_eval; the compile loop detects bare '[' only at statement/declaration-stream boundaries when exactly one active language declares a stream hook; constructor emission is shared and marks parsed:host_eval origins/expected_role. Expression/index/table-key bracket forms remain copied as normal Lua. Checks: inline FakeStreamT007 syntax.compile test confirmed only statement-position [generated] becomes a constructor while return a [b] and table {[generated]=1} remain Lua; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Replace Lalin HostEscape construction with LLBL HostEval
tasks.detail: Require `llbl`, replace/evolve `Ast.resolve_host_escapes` into HostEval evaluation that calls `llbl.host_eval.resolve/evaluate` for `__llbl_tag == "HostEval"` while keeping a temporary legacy HostEscape branch only if needed for tests during migration. Keep evaluation eager at constructor build time; adaptation remains later.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/lalin/syntax/ast.lua: required llbl; Ast.eval_lua_expr now delegates to llbl.host_eval.parsed evaluation; added Ast.resolve_host_evals that eagerly evaluates LLBL HostEval nodes via :evaluate(env), keeps a temporary legacy HostEscape branch, and aliases resolve_host_escapes; Ast.walk now visits HostEval child fields but stops at HostEval itself so evaluated external values are not recursively mutated. Checks: inline luajit HostEval/legacy HostEscape/external-value walk smoke; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Emit HostEval from Lalin type parser and support field splices
tasks.detail: Use `llbl.host_eval.parsed` instead of `Ast.node("HostEscape", ...)` for bracketed type positions. In `parse_field_block` and parameter/product contexts, recognize a leading `[` as a product-role HostEval splice item, not a named field. Share ref extraction through the new AST/HostEval helper.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/lalin/syntax/ast.lua and lua/lalin/syntax/type.lua: added shared Ast.extract_refs/Ast.add_refs/Ast.host_eval helpers; Type.parse now emits llbl HostEval with expected_role=type for bracketed type positions; Type.parse_params and Type.parse_field_block recognize leading '[' entries as product-role HostEval splices via Type.parse_product_splice. Checks: inline luajit type/params/field-block HostEval parse smoke; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Emit HostEval from Lalin expression parser
tasks.detail: Replace atom-level HostEscape with LLBL HostEval for leading `[ ... ]` only. Preserve postfix `expr[index]` as parsed `Index`, and keep nested brackets inside HostEval source opaque Lua source. Share ref extraction with type parser.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/lalin/syntax/expr.lua: removed duplicate ref extraction in favor of Ast.extract_refs/Ast.add_refs; atom-level leading [ ... ] now emits LLBL HostEval with expected_role=expr/channel parsed:host_eval; postfix expr[index] parsing is unchanged, so a[b] remains parsed Index and [make()][i] is HostEval atom plus parsed Index. Also updated lua/lalin/syntax/ast.lua to set HostEval.resolved=true after eager evaluation for legacy tests during migration. Checks: inline luajit expression HostEval/index/nested-bracket parse smoke; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Add statement and declaration role HostEval parse sites
tasks.detail: In statement blocks, recognize a leading `[` as a statement-list HostEval item instead of only an expression statement. The resulting AST node should carry expected role `stmts`/`stmt` so lowering can splice through LLBL role algebra.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/lalin/syntax/stmt.lua: Stmt.parse now recognizes leading [ ... ] in statement/block position, captures refs through Ast.extract_refs/Ast.add_refs, and emits LLBL HostEval with expected_role=stmts/channel parsed:host_eval instead of parsing it as a StmtExpr HostEscape. Checks: inline luajit statement block HostEval parse smoke; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Add union/region/declaration HostEval parse sites
tasks.detail: Allow bracket HostEval entries in union variant lists, region continuation lists, and declaration streams where the parser owns a current role. Add `Decl.parse_host_eval`/`parse_decl_stream` helpers for the driver hook. Do not alter `expr[index]` parsing.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/lalin/syntax/decl.lua: added Decl.parse_host_eval and Decl.parse_decl_stream helpers that emit LLBL HostEval with expected role; union bodies accept leading [ ... ] entries as variants-role HostEval; region input product lists accept product HostEval splices; continuation exit lists accept conts-role HostEval; continuation payload tuples accept product HostEval entries. Checks: inline luajit union/region/decl-stream HostEval parse-site smoke; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Create Lalin parsed role adapter module
tasks.detail: New module bound to an ASDL context and recursive lowering callbacks. Implement role-local adapters for type, expr, stmt/stmts, decl/decls, product fields, variants, and continuations. Include declaration-to-type projection for DeclStruct/DeclUnion/DeclHandle, schema-context TypeValue projection, nil policies, deterministic declaration list handling, and LLBL diagnostics with HostEval origin/value origin.
tasks.evidence: Created lua/lalin/syntax/role_adapter.lua. The module binds to the active ASDL context, unwraps/evaluates LLBL HostEval values, projects schema-context type values through TypeValue, implements declaration-to-type projection for DeclStruct/DeclUnion/DeclHandle, supports expr/place/stmt/stmts adapters with recursive lowering callbacks, deterministic decls collection with sorted keyed entries, product/variants/conts list collectors, nil policies, and LLBL diagnostic failures. Checks: luajit require/instantiate smoke; inline adapter smoke for DeclStruct-to-type, sorted keyed decls, HostEval product fields, and stmt Fragment handling; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Use role adapters in parsed tree lowering
tasks.detail: Instantiate `role_adapter`, replace HostEscape-specific expression/type/place/statement branches with HostEval/role-adapter calls, remove `stmt_splice` as an ad hoc special case, and expose adapter helpers for module lowering. Ensure adapted ASDL nodes carry bracket origin where possible.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/lalin/syntax/to_tree.lua and lua/lalin/syntax/role_adapter.lua: ToTree now instantiates the Lalin role adapter, handles LLBL HostEval in expr/type/place/stmt paths, routes legacy HostEscape through the adapter, replaces stmt_splice with adapter:stmt, exposes decl/product/variant/cont adapter helpers, and uses the local stmt_list wrapper from adapter statement splicing. Role adapter also unwraps legacy HostEscape. Checks: inline to_tree adapter smoke for HostEval type/expr/stmts/decls; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua). Note: luajit tests/run.lua frontend was attempted and currently fails in known downstream pending areas (syntax/init module lowering still has old HostEscape parsed_type path; Lua DSL type slot handling still needs HostEval unwrapping), which correspond to later edit-plan tasks rather than incomplete to_tree wiring.

tasks.title: Use role adapters in Lalin syntax module conversion
tasks.detail: Update constructor wrapping to evaluate HostEval objects without adapting. Replace local parsed_type/collect_parsed_decls duplicate logic with role_adapter/to_tree helpers. Add/register syntax hooks for declaration-stream HostEval if supported by the driver. Remove HostEscape assumptions from to_module.
tasks.evidence: Implemented in lua/lalin/syntax/init.lua plus role_adapter fix: constructor wrapping now calls Ast.resolve_host_evals; registered parse_host_eval/parse_decl_stream hooks with decl_stream_role=decls; to_module now uses to_tree/role_adapter for parsed_type, product fields, variants, and declaration collection, removing duplicate HostEscape-only parsed_type/collect logic. tasks.title: Port Lalin Lua DSL roles to descriptors
tasks.detail: Define explicit descriptors for `type`, `expr`, `decl`, `decls`, `stmt`, `stmts`, `product`, `params`, `variants`, `conts`, and `value`. Replace custom role_array/spread compatibility internals with LLBL descriptor-driven role algebra while preserving Lalin zone/LanguageBundle rules via adapter hooks. Update `slot_type` to admit `index:host` and let the type adapter project DSL declarations to types.

Checks: inline loader.loadstring smoke with statement-position [generated] under merged env compiled and ran; (cd tests && luajit syntax_smoke.lua).

tasks.title: Align LLPVM fragment handling with qualified roles
tasks.detail: Update LLPVM's permissive fragment/spread expansion to use LLBL role descriptor/fragment compatibility helpers instead of unqualified bare `Fragment` acceptance. Preserve existing LLPVM tests by declaring compatible LLPVM role ids/descriptors rather than relying on string collisions.

tasks.title: Update Lalin compile boundary for HostEval declaration lists
tasks.detail: Teach `parsed_decls_from` to recognize HostEval/Fragment/list declaration streams through the role adapter instead of only raw parsed `Decl*` tables. Preserve deterministic order; reject unordered keyed tables unless explicitly assigning names to parsed declarations.
